motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single ease for every transition and keyframe.

motion.name: depthIn
motion.purpose: A section rises from behind the cockpit.

motion.name: layerIn
motion.value: 500ms; translateY(14px), stagger 50ms per child, capped at 200ms

motion.name: zoom-into-row
motion.value: 700ms tower transition; scale clamp(1.4, fit, 2.5); hand-off at 430ms
motion.purpose: Deck row zooms in; others fade and blur 4px.

motion.name: window-to-card
motion.value: 450ms pane transform + background cyan to s1; real card fades in 250ms
motion.purpose: The lit window grows into the review card.

motion.name: zoom-out
motion.value: from scale 2.2 back to 1, 700ms, then refocus the row
motion.purpose: Back from a deck lands on the same row.

motion.name: light-change
motion.purpose: Lamp colour, cone and glow cross-fades.

motion.name: ignite
motion.purpose: Streak gauge when today's goal is met, once.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation/transition 0.01ms; zoom and pane skipped in script
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce gives a plain cut.

narrative.overview:
The daily habit is a cockpit seen at night: an ink-blue deck under a faint plotting grid, hairline panels, drawn line icons, and one cyan signal that says "this is active" or "do this". The streak is the cockpit's main gauge and the only warm instrument on the panel. The book is the payload: the reading page sits in the middle of the console and is the one place where expression yields entirely to legibility.

Density is calm-operational. Panels are flat and outlined, not lifted; numbers that are measurements read as instrument readouts in monospace; everything else is the system UI sans. Depth is spatial, not decorative: every section rises one layer from behind the cockpit, and a pull-cord lamp changes the light rather than a toggle changing a theme. The direction refuses both the cream-paper bookish default and the neon-glow cockpit.

The sign-in pages are the one room with mood lighting: a standing lamp whose cord cycles the whole room through cyan, warm, violet, and lights out, and the form takes its accent from the lamp.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-blue deck (`bg`) with a 32px plotting grid at 3.5% cyan and one soft cyan radial wash.
One cyan signal for state and action; amber only for the habit and warm notes.
System sans for interface, monospace only for measurements, book serif for reading and italic accent words.
Hairline borders carry structure; one shadow exists and it is reserved for floating layers.
Motion means depth: sections rise, contents arrive in layers, answers turn over, a deck row zooms in and a window becomes the card.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only colour that means "active" or "act". Never introduce a second accent for buttons, links, or selection.

rules.name: The Habit Owns Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the streak and warm notes. It is never a button, a link, a selection, or a decorative highlight.

rules.name: The Paper Is Only the Page Rule
rules.body: Paper mode changes the book page and nothing else; the cockpit around it stays dark.

rules.name: The Measurement-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for numbers that are measurements (streak, counts, levels, percentages, page numbers) and code. Never for headings, labels, or prose.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Word Rule
rules.body: A heading may set one or two words in the book serif italic (500) as its accent: cyan-ink in the app ("Your *decks*", "A little English, *every day*"), the lamp colour on sign-in. One accent phrase per heading.

rules.name: The Reading Wins Rule
rules.body: In long text, legibility beats expression: serif at 19-20px, 1.85-1.9 leading, 68ch measure, AA contrast in both night and paper.

rules.name: The Habit Always Visible Rule
rules.body: The streak gauge (desktop) or streak chip (phone) is on screen in the reader at every width.

rules.name: The Float Earns the Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets the shadow only if it floats over other content. Resting panels use a border and a tonal step.

rules.name: The Plotting Grid Rule
rules.body: The deck background is a 32px grid of 1px lines at 3.5% `cyan-ink` plus one faint cyan radial wash (`.deck-grid`). It stays subliminal; never raise its opacity or animate it.

rules.name: The One Protagonist Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one featured motion (a section rising, a row zooming, a card turning, the cord). Nothing loops except the sign-in fireflies.

dos: **Do** take colours from `static/theme.css` tokens (`var(--cyan)`, `var(--s1)`…) and add any new colour there as a token. A few literal hover and state shades remain in pages (`#63dcef` primary hover, `#3a4f78` hover border); don't add more.
**Do** keep cyan as the single signal for active and primary; one filled primary button per view.
**Do** use amber only for the streak/habit and warm notes.
**Do** set measurements in monospace with tabular numerals and everything else in the system sans; use the book serif for reading surfaces and italic accent words.
**Do** separate resting surfaces with 1px hairlines and tonal steps; give the pop shadow only to floating layers.
**Do** draw icons from the inline SVG sprite (24px grid, 1.7 stroke, `currentColor`).
**Do** make every new section enter with `depthIn` and its children with `layerIn`, and check it under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** use `uiDialog` / `uiConfirm` / `uiPrompt` for any question to the user, with `danger: true` for destructive ones.
donts: **Don't** use emoji or text glyphs as icons; use the sprite.
**Don't** add neon glows to UI chrome (text, buttons, borders, panels). Glow belongs only to the lamps' light: bulbs, cones, floor pools, fireflies, and the paper-mode page glow.
**Don't** run more than one protagonist motion per screen, and don't loop motion in the app.
**Don't** draw a literal building (facade, skyline, roofline) anywhere. Decks borrow only storey rows and window strips; the full building metaphor is reserved for the future language picker.
**Don't** let paper mode restyle the cockpit; it changes only the `--page*` tokens.
**Don't** set prose, labels, or headings in monospace.
